units.title: SG-6.4.5 · Unit tests with mocked fetch for Reject, Approve, Retry and 401 behaviour
Act: Confirm AdminApp 401 branch covers Retry and Reject
Act: Confirm rejectExecution encoding and non-401 failure display
Verify: Retry and Reject 401 return to the token gate unit tests

tests.id: retry endpoint returns 401 shows the token gate
tests.name: retry endpoint returns 401 shows the token gate
tests.title: Retry endpoint returns 401 shows the token gate with 'Invalid token'
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution whose retry endpoint returns 401, when Retry is clicked, then the alert shows 'Invalid token' and the 'Admin token' field is shown again
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "retry endpoint returns 401" --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: reject endpoint returns 401 shows the token gate
tests.name: reject endpoint returns 401 shows the token gate
tests.title: Reject endpoint returns 401 shows the token gate with 'Invalid token'
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution whose reject endpoint returns 401, when Reject is clicked, then the alert shows 'Invalid token' and the 'Admin token' field is shown again
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "reject endpoint returns 401" --testTimeout=20000

units.title: Verify: rejectExecution id encoding and Reject failure display unit tests

tests.id: rejectExecution encodes the id in the URL
tests.name: encodes the id in the URL
tests.title: rejectExecution encodes the id in the URL
tests.scenario: Given a fetch stub returning the execution fixture, When rejectExecution('tok', 'a/b c') is called, Then the request path is /api/v1/admin/executions/a%2Fb%20c/reject
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/executions.test.ts -t "encodes the id" --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: AdminApp reject endpoint returns 500 shows the message
tests.name: reject endpoint returns 500 shows the message
tests.title: Reject failure shows the server error message in the Execution region
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution whose reject endpoint returns 500 with {error:'boom'}, When Reject is clicked, Then the Execution region has an alert with text 'boom'
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "reject endpoint returns 500" --testTimeout=20000
